title: Total displacement magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total displacement from deceleration start to normal speed restoration as 885 m.

title: Time saved calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the time saved after the speed increase as 8.5 s.

title: Deceleration displacement calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply kinematic equations to find displacement during deceleration from v₀ to v₁ or v₂.

title: Time for constant velocity section
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the time to travel distance d at either v₁ or v₂.

title: Total time comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate total times T₁ and T₂ for both scenarios and find their difference.

title: Symmetry of acceleration phases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may note that acceleration and deceleration phases are symmetric with equal magnitudes.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may demonstrate consistent unit conversion between km/h and m/s where needed.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses positive acceleration during deceleration phases.

title: Missing constant velocity section
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student omits the 10 m constant velocity section in displacement or time calculations.
